# Set up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fastcmprsk, lib.loc = "/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.5-arm64/Resources/library")
library(survival)
```

# Easy sim

```{r}
easy_sim <- function(nobs =50,
                     beta1,
                     beta2){
  sim <- simulateTwoCauseFineGrayModel(nobs = nobs,
                                       beta1 = beta1,
                                       beta2 = beta2,
                                       X = NULL,
                                       u.min = 100,
                                       u.max = 100,
                                       p = 0.5,
                                       returnX = TRUE)

  sim_data <- cbind(data.frame(ID = 1:nobs,
                               TTE = sim$ftime,
                               Status = as.integer(sim$fstatus)),
                    sim$X)

  names(sim_data)<- c("ID", "TTE", "Status", paste0("X_", 1:(ncol(sim_data)-3)))

  x <- as.matrix(sim_data %>%select(starts_with("X")))
  y <- as.matrix(sim_data %>%
                   mutate(Status = as.numeric(Status))%>%
                   select(TTE, Status))

  return(list("dataframe" = sim_data,
              "x" = x,
              "y" = y))
}

easy_sim_wrapper <- function(x,
                             nobs = 50,
                             beta1_active = c(0.40, - 0.50, 0.60, 0.75, - 0.80),
                             beta2_active = c(0, 0.3, 0, 0, -0.2),
                             iter.max = 20){
data <- easy_sim(nobs,
                     c(beta1_active, rep(0,x-length(beta1_active))),
                     c(beta2_active, rep(0,x-length(beta1_active)))
)


fg_data <- data$dataframe
fg_data$Status_factor <- factor(fg_data$Status,
                           levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                           labels = c("censor", "event", "competing"))
fg_data_format <- finegray(Surv(TTE, Status_factor) ~ ., data = fg_data, etype = "event")

sparse_fg_formula <- paste("Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ ",
                           paste0("X_", 1:length(beta1_active), collapse = " + "))

full_fg_formula <- paste("Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ ",
                           paste0("X_", 1:x, collapse = " + "))

sparse_fg_model <- coxph(as.formula(sparse_fg_formula),
                  weight = fgwt,
                  data = fg_data_format,
                  control = coxph.control(iter.max = iter.max))

# A coxph fit is treated as converged if it stopped before hitting the
# iteration cap AND all coefficients are finite (guards against the
# monotone-likelihood / separation blow-ups).
sparse_iter <- max(sparse_fg_model$iter)
sparse_converged <- isTRUE(sparse_iter < iter.max) &&
  all(is.finite(sparse_fg_model$coefficients))

if(x < nobs){
  full_fg_model <- coxph(as.formula(full_fg_formula),
                  weight = fgwt,
                  data = fg_data_format,
                  control = coxph.control(iter.max = iter.max))

  full_fg_ests <- as.vector(full_fg_model$coefficients)
  full_iter <- max(full_fg_model$iter)
  full_converged <- isTRUE(full_iter < iter.max) &&
    all(is.finite(full_fg_model$coefficients))
}else{
  full_fg_ests <- rep(NA, x)
  full_iter <- NA
  full_converged <- NA
}





comparisons <- data.frame(Name = c(paste("V", 1:x, sep = "")),
                   True_beta = c(beta1_active,
                                 rep(0, x-length(beta1_active))),
                   Sparse_FG_beta = c(as.vector(sparse_fg_model$coefficients),
                                 rep(0, x-length(beta1_active))),
                   Full_FG_beta = full_fg_ests
)

return(list(data = data,
            comparisons = comparisons,
            # `converged` gates on the sparse FG model, since that is the
            # estimate the bias analysis relies on.
            converged = sparse_converged,
            convergence = list(sparse = sparse_converged,
                               full = full_converged,
                               sparse_iter = sparse_iter,
                               full_iter = full_iter,
                               iter.max = iter.max)))
}
```

# Plotting

```{r}
plot_ests <- function(predictors, 
                      show_full_fg = FALSE,
                      separate_actives = FALSE,
                      nobs = 50,
                      beta1_active = c(0.40, - 0.50, 0.60, 0.75, - 0.80), 
                      beta2_active = c(0, 0.3, 0, 0, -0.2)){
  
  sim <- easy_sim_wrapper(predictors, nobs, beta1_active, beta2_active)
  
  long <- sim$comparisons %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(-Name),
               names_to = "Model",
               values_to = "Est")%>%
  mutate(Active = ifelse(Name %in% paste0("V", 1:length(beta1_active)), TRUE, FALSE))%>%
  transform(Name = factor(Name,
                          levels = stringr::str_sort(unique(Name), numeric = TRUE)))
  
  if(predictors > nobs | show_full_fg == FALSE ){
  long <- long %>%
      filter(Model != "Full_FG_beta")
  }
  

  plot <- ggplot(long , aes(x = Name,
                                     y = Est,
                                     color = Model))+
  geom_point()
  
  if(separate_actives){
    plot <- plot+
  facet_wrap(~Active, scales = "free_x")
  }
  
  plot
}
```

```{r}

plot_ests(predictors = 5, show_full_fg = TRUE)
plot_ests(predictors = 25, separate_actives = TRUE, show_full_fg = TRUE)
plot_ests(predictors = 100, separate_actives = TRUE)
```

# Visualizing fine and gray bias

```{r}
# Run `n_iter` simulations and collect the sparse Fine-Gray bias
# (Sparse_FG_beta - True_beta) for each predictor on every iteration.
sim_fg_bias <- function(predictors,
                        n_iter = 100,
                        nobs = 50,
                        beta1_active = c(0.40, -0.50, 0.60, 0.75, -0.80),
                        beta2_active = c(0, 0.3, 0, 0, -0.2),
                        iter_max = 20,
                        iter_max_retry = 100,
                        base_seed = 1) {

  bias_iters <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_iter), function(i) {
    seed_i <- base_seed + i

    # First attempt at the default iteration cap. Seeding per iteration
    # makes the retry reproduce the *same* simulated data.
    set.seed(seed_i)
    sim <- suppressWarnings(
      easy_sim_wrapper(predictors, nobs, beta1_active, beta2_active,
                       iter.max = iter_max)
    )

    # Retry once, on the same data, with a larger iteration cap.
    if (!sim$converged) {
      set.seed(seed_i)
      sim <- suppressWarnings(
        easy_sim_wrapper(predictors, nobs, beta1_active, beta2_active,
                         iter.max = iter_max_retry)
      )
    }

    # Still not converged after the retry -> skip this iteration.
    if (!sim$converged) return(NULL)

    sim$comparisons %>%
      mutate(Bias = Sparse_FG_beta - True_beta,
             Iteration = i) %>%
      select(Name, True_beta, Sparse_FG_beta, Bias, Iteration)
  })

  n_used    <- dplyr::n_distinct(bias_iters$Iteration)
  n_skipped <- n_iter - n_used
  if (n_skipped > 0) {
    message(n_skipped, " of ", n_iter,
            " iterations skipped (did not converge after retry).")
  }

  bias_summary <- bias_iters %>%
    group_by(Name, True_beta) %>%
    summarise(Avg_bias = mean(Bias),
              SE_bias  = sd(Bias) / sqrt(n()),
              Avg_est = mean(Sparse_FG_beta),
              SD_est = sd(Sparse_FG_beta),
              Med_est = median(Sparse_FG_beta),
              Q3_est = quantile(Sparse_FG_beta, 0.75),
              Q1_est = quantile(Sparse_FG_beta, 0.25),
              .groups  = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Active = Name %in% paste0("V", seq_along(beta1_active)),
           Name   = factor(Name,
                           levels = stringr::str_sort(unique(Name),
                                                      numeric = TRUE)))

  list(iterations = bias_iters,
       summary    = bias_summary,
       n_used     = n_used,
       n_skipped  = n_skipped)
}

# Plot the average bias per predictor with +/- 1 SE error bars.
plot_fg_bias <- function(predictors,
                         active_only = TRUE, 
                         n_iter = 100,
                         nobs = 50,
                         beta1_active = c(0.40, -0.50, 0.60, 0.75, -0.80),
                         beta2_active = c(0, 0.3, 0, 0, -0.2),
                         ...) {

  res <- sim_fg_bias(predictors, n_iter, nobs, beta1_active, beta2_active, ...)
  
  if(active_only){
    res$summary <- res$summary %>%
      filter(Active == TRUE)
  }

 p1 <-  ggplot(res$summary) +
    #geom_hline(aes(x = Name, y = Avg_est, color = Active), yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
   geom_point(aes(x = Name, y = Avg_est, color = Active))+
    geom_errorbar(aes(x = Name, ymin =Avg_est - 1.96*SD_est,
                      ymax = Avg_est + 1.96*SD_est, color = Active),
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(x = Name, y = True_beta), color = "black", shape = "square") +
    labs(x = "Predictor",
         y = "Average Estimate",
         color = "Active",
         title = paste0("Average sparse Fine-Gray estimate over ",
                        n_iter, " iterations"),
         caption = "Error bars show 95% interval of the estimators sampling distribution. (Est +/- 1.96*SD(Estimate))") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))
  
  p2 <- ggplot(res$summary, aes(x = Name, y = Avg_bias, color = Active)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Avg_bias - SE_bias,
                      ymax = Avg_bias + SE_bias),
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(x = "Predictor",
         y = "Average bias (Sparse FG - True beta)",
         color = "Active",
         title = paste0("Average sparse Fine-Gray bias over ",
                        n_iter, " iterations"),
         caption = "Error bars show standard error of the bias. (SD(Bias)/sqrt(iterations))") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))
  
  print(p1)
  print(p2)
}
```

```{r}

plot_fg_bias(predictors = 5, n_iter = 100, nobs = 50)

```
